purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Answering Cut at Three-Bell Gate.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary gate ritual, preparation choices, delver withdrawal, the answering organ, competing interpretations, the binding decision, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate anchors for the chamber, offering routine, preparation, returned party, first impossible bell, answering-organ reveal, interpretation, company demand, final commitment, each ending family, and the last material echo. The first bell sentence stands alone.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Every base image prompt is a complete frame for a general image model, with visible geometry, materials, light, bodies, clothing, tools, and positions. Continuity notes remain reviewer constraints. Character refs are assembled only for characters visible in the frame.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, hand-painted gouache and fine ink linework, luminous mineral magic, soot-dark dwarven stonework, tactile brass machinery, restrained jewel colors, expressive faces and posture, clear interactive-fiction staging, numinous wonder held beside practical labor.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the complete scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters and groups listed as visible in that scene, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Keep visual_continuity_notes outside the generated prompt. Use a camera-specific render from the future blockout when high-consistency art is commissioned.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture contains a measured draft map with stable zones, routes, cameras, sightlines, staging positions, and branch-persistent machinery states. This supports review and prompt planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Build a plan view or simple 3D blockout before multi-angle website rendering. Preserve the west lift, brass withdrawal line, three east arches, raised listening niche, offering bench, central pump and folded cutter, safety rails, gauge wall, messenger tube, and answering-organ anchor.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide view eastward through Three-Bell Gate, a twenty-four-meter-long dwarven listening chamber carved from dark basalt two lift descents below a warm underground sea. A square freight lift fills the west wall behind the camera position; a brass withdrawal strip crosses the black stone floor one third of the room from the west. Three arched passages face the viewer on the east wall: a broad central crystal-working face, a narrow left gallery bending north, and a small sealed right alcove. A heavy dark stone bell hangs in each arch. A direct mana pump with blue crystal pipes and a folded rune cutter sit behind waist-high brass safety rails before the central arch. An offering bench stands along the northwest wall, and a shallow goblin listening niche overlooks the left arch. Amber oil lamps and faint blue rune gauges light damp stone, old route marks, iron grates, and thin mineral seams.
visual_continuity_notes: Local frame is west-to-east: lift and public landing west, three arches east, alternate north-left, rest south-right.
The brass withdrawal line stays west of every arch, the pump, the folded cutter, and the active answering-organ wall.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide workplace ritual at the northwest offering bench of a dark basalt gate hall. Master Nera Ashmark, a stocky middle-aged dwarf woman with warm brown skin, a square black braid threaded with copper rings, a soot-blue wool work coat, brass civic-seal chain, and scarred hands, weighs three thumbnail mana crystals beside three loaves and three twists of dried mushroom. Pekk-of-Wet-Stone, a lean green-gold goblin adult with long mobile ears, broad nose, amber eyes, copper-dusted leather vest, and soft dark boots, leans from a low listening stair and studies the scales. Captain Sava Tern, a tall dark-brown-skinned human woman with one shaved temple, black curls tied back, worn leather scale armor, iron gauntlets, and a nicked open helmet, checks straps on three armored delvers. Dorrik Vane, a compact pale-brown dwarf man with a trimmed russet beard, tailored iron-grey coat, polished boots, and a brass gauge case, waits beside a blue-lit direct-pump dial. The three eastern stone bells and brass withdrawal line remain visible beyond them under amber lamps.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide numinous reveal at the three east arches of a dwarven basalt gate hall. Warm overlapping stone scales seal the broad central crystal face. The narrow left gallery stands open and exhales pale mist.
